name: ring_attractor
signature: columnar population + 2-hop inhibitory kernel ∝ 1−cos(Δθ) + mirror-symmetric shifter
conventional_equivalent: continuous-attractor heading estimator (cf. EKF orientation tracking — same problem, not same mechanism)

evidence.item: kernel contrast (min at bump, max opposite)
dynamics: realised Delta7 kernel on the ring

counterevidence: calibrated LIF does not sustain a free-running bump without tonic drive — the attractor is structurally present but subthreshold in this model
predicted transmitter signs; receptor kinetics and delays unmodelled
predictions: lesion Delta7 → kernel contrast collapses, bump fragments
sustained unilateral PEN drive → persistent heading drift at rate ∝ drive asymmetry
sufficient tonic EPG excitation → bump persists in darkness

name: phasor_vector_shift
signature: sinusoidal population code + fixed columnar offset between input and output + convergent summation
conventional_equivalent: coordinate transform — but the transform is partially compiled into the wiring

evidence.item: hDelta fans out at peak offset +4/+5 columns (≈180°) to downstream types
PFN phasor arms arrive at hDelta with opposite-sign offsets

counterevidence: static offsets only — the summation step is measured, the phase-shifted phasor arithmetic is inferred from anatomy + literature
FB has 10 columns but PB-derived offsets are mod-8; the 180° reading assumes the published phase convention
predictions: drive PFNv/PFNd → hDelta output phasor rotates by the wired offset
silence hDelta → travel-direction signal lost, heading intact
reduced_model: out[col] = sum(in[col - offset])   # the adder is wiring, not arithmetic

name: motion_correlator
signature: ON/OFF channel split + identical input composition across directional subtypes + spatial offset of inputs

evidence.item: lamina splits ON/OFF with no cross-talk

counterevidence: the delay arm is implemented by temporal dynamics of the interneurons — not measurable from connectivity alone
direction selectivity is inferred from anatomy + physiology literature, not proven by the graph
predictions: silence T4a → behavioural responses to front-to-back motion lost only
the four subtypes should tile all directions; the fifth found would break the model
reduced_model: y = thresh( x[t, r] * x[t-τ, r+δ] - x[t-τ, r] * x[t, r+δ] )   # per subtype δ

name: convolution_front_end
signature: one cell type per column, identical partner counts, low CV of total weight across columns

evidence.item: 47 types with one copy per column

counterevidence: positional variation exists (some pairs CV ~0.36) — not a perfect convolution
predictions: kernel transfer: a feature learned at one eccentricity should hold at all eccentricities
reduced_model: out[:, x] = K * in[:, x]   # same K for all columns

name: sparse_associative_memory
signature: large sparse expansion + near-random input mixing + global feedback inhibition + compartmental modulatory gating
conventional_equivalent: locality-sensitive hashing + linear readout (FlyHash); three-factor Hebbian rather than backprop

evidence.item: dynamics: ABL silencing broadens KC code

counterevidence: no plasticity in the sim — the learning rule is inferred from DAN anatomy, not demonstrated
odor identity of PN channels is anatomical, not verified per-channel
predictions: present odor + shock → MBON valence flips for that odor only
lesion APL → code density rises, discrimination falls
reduced_model:
x = topk(sparse_random_project(odor), k=5%)
value = W_dan_gated @ x   # W updated locally by DAN reward signal

name: feedforward_inhibition
signature: A→B plus A→I→B with I inhibitory

evidence.item: share of strong E edges with a parallel I path

counterevidence: fractional sign: some edges counted E are mixed
predictions: blocking the I arm should broaden temporal tuning of B
reduced_model: y = x[t] - g·x[t-1]   # implemented as A→B and A→I→B

name: winner_take_all
counterevidence: measured at type level; neuron-level I↔I is even more numerous
predictions: simultaneous strong drive to both sides → bistability / oscillation rather than compromise
reduced_model: a.x -= g*b.x; b.x -= g*a.x   # last-one-standing dynamics

name: divisive_normalization
signature: inhibitory cell whose dominant input population equals its dominant output population

evidence.item: AL LNs span glomeruli broadly + presynaptic LN→ORN feedback

counterevidence: in/out-overlap does not prove divisive (could be subtractive) — needs the nonlinearity
predictions: inject a common-mode offset into the population → output ratios preserved

name: command_funnel
signature: many circuits converge onto a small set of descending channels

evidence.item: share of brain output carried by DNs
DN↔AN loop weight comparable to DN output

counterevidence: the funnel count mixes cell types with very different functions — a bottleneck of bandwidth, not necessarily of decisions
predictions: silence a single DN type → a specific motor program drops out

name: feedforward_inhibition

counterevidence: only 179/302 neurons have NT assignments; sign-conditioned counts undercount

name: winner_take_all

evidence.item: I↔I is the most common neuron-level 2-cycle

counterevidence: at type level I↔I enrichment is absent (z≈−0.4): the motif lives at cell resolution because worm motor classes are singletons
command rivalry could also be implemented by excitatory-biased bistability, not only I↔I
predictions: lesion one member of an I↔I pair → its rival tonically wins
